title: Ticketing platform agreement for Centre In The Square
subtitle: Brief special meeting also covered an in-camera session, a recess, and routine by-law readings.
overview: Council held a short special meeting on March 2, 2026. After opening, members authorized a closed session on two matters: one about security of property and negotiations, and one about negotiations and solicitor-client privilege. Council then recessed while that session took place.

When council reconvened, chaired by Acting Mayor D. Chapman, it passed one motion arising from the closed session. Staff are authorized to negotiate with Paciolan and Centre In The Square to put a new ticketing platform in place, on terms discussed in closed session {{vote:m2}}. The Chief Administrative Officer may sign the agreements once the City Solicitor is satisfied with them.

This matters to residents because it affects how tickets are sold for arts and entertainment events at Centre In The Square. The public record does not give the detailed terms, costs or timing. Council also gave the by-laws their readings, including the by-law confirming the meeting's actions, and then adjourned.

decisions.detail: Staff were authorized to negotiate a ticketing platform with Paciolan and Centre In The Square, and the Chief Administrative Officer may execute the agreements to the City Solicitor's satisfaction {{vote:m2}}.
